turns.content: What's a good warmup before deadlifts?
Hip hinges with a dowel, a few glute bridges, then two light ramp-up sets.
Cool, adding that to my pull day.
Is the TTC running normally on Line 1 this morning?
I can't check live service from here. The TTC site or app has current alerts.
Explain Thevenin equivalents like I'm tired.
Any linear circuit seen from two terminals acts like one voltage source in series with one resistor.
And Norton is the current source version?
Yes. Same circuit, a current source in parallel with the same resistor.
Cookie keeps barking at the mail carrier, any tips?
Reward calm behaviour before the knock, and practise with someone ringing the bell on purpose.
Okay, long night. Cookie (the app) keeps getting slow after a while. Can we go through it?
Sure. What does slow mean here: time to first token, or tokens per second?
First token. It starts around 0.4 s and creeps up to like 1.5 s after a long chat.
That's usually the prompt growing. Is the context staying under the 32K cap?
I think so. The log says n_ctx 32768 and the prompt was about 9k tokens on the last one.
At 9k tokens, a cold prompt takes a while to process. The cached prefix should help if the start of the prompt stays stable.
How do I check if the cache is getting hit?
Look for the cached tokens count in the timings, or tokens_cached on the stored turn.
tokens_cached is 0 on half the turns. That seems bad.
It is. Something near the top of the prompt is probably changing every turn, like a timestamp.
Oh, the system prompt has the current time in it. Down to the second.
That would bust the cache every turn. Move the time to the end, or round it to the hour.

Moving it to the end. Rebuilding now. While that builds, random thing: I switched Cookie's food to Open Farm small-breed lamb, she gets half a cup twice a day, the old kibble was giving her itchy skin. Anyway, build's done.
Hope the new food helps her skin. How does first token look after the rebuild?
0.38 s on turn 1, 0.41 s on turn 12. Way better.
That's the cache working. tokens_cached should be most of the prompt now.
Yep, like 8.6k of 9k cached. What about RAM? Activity Monitor says 31 GB used.
On a 64 GB M1 Max with a 35B MoE at Q4 plus the embedder, that's expected.
Should I worry about swap?
Only if memory pressure goes yellow. Green is fine.
Green. Okay, I'll commit this. Message?
Something like: move the timestamp to the end of the system prompt to keep the prefix cache warm.
Done. Going to bed.
Good night.
Give me a high-protein breakfast that isn't eggs.
Overnight oats with whey and Greek yogurt, about 40 g of protein.
Perfect, I'll prep that tonight.
Why does my Swift build say a module is missing after I pulled main?
Usually a stale package cache. Try resolving packages again, then a clean build.
Remind me what a buck converter's duty cycle relates to.
In an ideal buck converter, Vout = D x Vin.
Weather's getting cold. Does Cookie need a jacket for walks?
Small dogs with thin coats often do below about 0 C. A light fleece is plenty for now.
